_meta.description: Tokens and list-price USD of a core run and a full run of every model. The scope a model actually ran is measured from its logs; the other scope is estimated from its measured tokens per question.
_meta.prices: tools/export_web/prices.json: list rates in USD per 1M tokens, never batch prices
_meta.tokens: Evaluated model only (input + output, reasoning included in output); judge tokens are listed separately and not counted.
_meta.run_type: core: answered only the core questions; full: answered the full benchmarks; mixed: some of each.
_meta.tasks: Per model and benchmark: run (core, full or partial), observed_items (questions answered) and the tokens measured in its logs. Benchmark sizes are in suite.tasks.
_meta.suite: Panel-wide core vs full tokens from each benchmark's tokens per question (average input plus median output across models).
_meta.ratio: full / core of the same model.
_meta.trend: Least-squares fit of log10(value) on years since 2024-01-01 (model release date), over the priced models.
_meta.size_control: full_usd fit on years and log10(total parameters); x_per_year_raw is the fit on years alone over the same models.
